rules.name: Time expression → predefined option
rules.rule: Pick the smallest option whose window fully covers the requested period (e.g. 'last 2 months' → In past 3 months). If no option covers it, use the largest option and set Ambiguous = Yes (approximation).

rules.name: 'Recently'
rules.rule: Job Changed / Promoted → In past 3 months. Last Funding Date → In past 6 months (smallest option).

rules.name: Numeric threshold on Revenue / Headcount
rules.rule: Threshold on a bucket edge (±1 unit) → predefined ranges fully inside the condition (primary); Custom Range acceptable. Threshold not on a bucket edge → Custom Range with the exact bound (primary); predefined ranges including the partially-overlapping one acceptable.

rules.name: Strict vs inclusive on typed ranges
rules.rule: Integer fields: '>N' → Min N+1, '≥N / at least N' → Min N, '<N' → Max N−1, '≤N / up to N' → Max N. Years: 'after Y' → Since Y+1, 'in or after / since Y' → Since Y, 'before Y' → Till Y−1. Currency fields treated as continuous ('>$20M' → Min 20,000,000).

rules.name: Negation on Yes/No filters
rules.rule: 'not a subsidiary', 'not multinational' → value No. This is not an Exclude operation.

rules.name: Location scope
rules.rule: Leads search: people / leads / contacts 'in X' → Lead location; 'companies in X', 'X-based companies', 'at <nationality> companies' → Global HQ Location. Accounts search → Global HQ Location.

rules.name: Ambiguous / non-indexed place names
rules.rule: Prefer the country/region meaning – a well-known country alias wins over small indexed places of the same name (Holland → Netherlands, not Holland, Texas; Ambiguous = No); otherwise the most prominent indexed match, and set Ambiguous = Yes when several indexed places match (London, New York, Mumbai). Names with no indexed match may be mapped through LLM knowledge to an indexed value (Holland → Netherlands, Silicon Valley → San Francisco Bay Area).

rules.name: Exact-only filters (Company, Parent Company)
rules.rule: Apply only when exactly one indexed record's name equals the text (case-insensitive) or a well-known alias resolves to one record (TCS). Several exact-name records, or none → Unresolved; Ambiguous = Yes when candidates exist.

rules.name: Vague size / stage words (PROPOSED – confirm)
rules.rule: small/SMB = 1-200; mid-market = 201-1000; large/enterprise = 1001+; startup/emerging = up to 200 employees + funded in past 12 months. Always Ambiguous = Yes.

rules.name: Concepts not in the Industry taxonomy
rules.rule: Use a sub-industry when one clearly matches (SaaS → Software Development; cybersecurity → Computer and Network Security). Otherwise fall back to Company Keywords (fintech, AI, metaverse).

rules.name: Exclusion on include-only multi-select filters
rules.rule: Include X but exclude a child Y → select X's children except Y (primary). Pure exclusion with no positive set → Unresolved (primary); complement selection acceptable.

rules.name: Exclusion through another filter
rules.rule: When an exclusion can be represented exactly by another filter that supports Exclude (e.g. Contact Keywords on job title), that is acceptable/primary.

rules.name: Single-select conflicts
rules.rule: First stated condition wins; later ones are Unresolved (IG-17217 AC10). Recommended spec change: for time periods prefer the wider option; for both Yes and No → no filter. Both are accepted as alternatives in this gold set.

rules.name: Contact Keywords scope
rules.rule: Job-title words → Current Job Title; responsibilities / skills → Current Job Description; past roles, experience, bio → All Jobs or Bios.

rules.name: Logic
rules.rule: Values inside one filter are OR. Different filters are AND. OR across filters → Unsupported (never silently converted to AND).

rules.name: Cross-entity
rules.rule: Company conditions on Leads search → applied (company filters exist on Leads tab). Person conditions on Accounts search → Unresolved (alternative: switch primary entity to Lead).

rules.name: Vague seniority words
rules.rule: 'senior' = Founder/CXO, VP, MD, Director, Head; 'decision makers' = Founder/CXO, VP, Director, Head; 'C-level / C-suite / execs' = Founder/CXO. Ambiguous = Yes for 'senior' and 'decision makers'.

rules.name: Org / ICP context
rules.rule: Use only the context in the org fixture. If the query references org context that does not exist → Unresolved directly, no keyword fallback.

rules.name: User-owned values
rules.rule: Lists and personas resolve only against the user's actual items; anything else → Unresolved.

rules.name: Entitlements
rules.rule: Filters not enabled for the org (Intent in the test org) → Unsupported (not entitled); never applied.
